patches.OLD_TEXT: a name that arrives without preparation, without the visitor having brought anything to the encounter except the willingness to walk in.
patches.TARGET_COMMITMENT: The visitor brought nothing to the encounter except the willingness to walk in (i.e. arrived wholly unprepared).
patches.SOURCE_ANCHOR: You can’t walk into a gallery without learning about some subcultural genius or longlost creative you’ve never heard of.
patches.WHY_GROUNDED: What remains asserts only that each room produces a name, which the source supports, and says nothing about what the visitor did or did not bring.
patches.SEMANTIC_CLOSURE_EXPLANATION: After the patch the parent sentence reads: "That is the texture of moving through it — a sequence of rooms, each producing a name." The flagged clause is gone and so is the residual carrier "that arrives without preparation", which independently asserted the visitor's unpreparedness; no weaker synonym (unprepared, unanticipated, without warning) and no adjacent phrase describing the visitor's state survives, and no grammatical remnant implies one.

patches.OLD_TEXT: taken here not because the review places them above the rest but simply because they can be set beside each other.
patches.NEW_TEXT: taken here because they can be set beside each other.
patches.TARGET_COMMITMENT: The review does not place these two names above the rest.
patches.WHY_GROUNDED: The repaired sentence makes no claim about how the review ranks or elevates any name; it states only this article's reason for pairing them.
patches.SEMANTIC_CLOSURE_EXPLANATION: After the patch the parent sentence reads: "Two of those names, taken here because they can be set beside each other." The negative claim about the review's ordering is gone, and the exclusivity word "simply" is removed as well, since "simply because" would still imply that no elevation by the review is in play; nothing left in the sentence characterises the review's ranking, preference or emphasis in any form.

patches.OLD_TEXT: Sadao Hasegawa's work, the review adds, stayed
patches.NEW_TEXT: Most of Sadao Hasegawa's work, the review adds, stayed
patches.TARGET_COMMITMENT: That his work stayed unpublished and unseen in his lifetime held without restriction, i.e. of all of it.
patches.SOURCE_ANCHOR: Most of the Japanese illustrator’s work, you guessed it, stayed unpublished and unseen in his lifetime.
patches.WHY_GROUNDED: The quantifier now matches the source exactly, which restricts the claim to most of his work rather than all of it.
patches.SEMANTIC_CLOSURE_EXPLANATION: After the patch the parent sentence reads: "Most of Sadao Hasegawa's work, the review adds, stayed unpublished and unseen in his lifetime." The bare plural that carried universal scope is now explicitly bounded by "Most of"; no bare or implicitly total reading of the subject remains, and no adjacent phrase in the sentence re-extends the claim to the whole body of work.
